mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand, which signals strong economic growth and positive equity market sentiment, leading to S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 95% of its 12-month moving average signals a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95% of 12-month MA, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive trend in nonfarm payrolls growth above 100,000 jobs per month indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent acceleration in GDP growth and housing starts indicates a robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, or interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 1.5% during a tightening cycle, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
